## Release (2026-11-01)

* ember-mobile-drawer 0.1.0 (minor)

#### :rocket: Enhancement
* `ember-mobile-drawer`
  * [#143](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/143) Drag the sheet to its highest snap point and scroll the content in the same pan ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#136](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/136) Scroll to the top and drag the sheet down in one gesture ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#137](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/137) Add an accessible grabber that moves the drawer to the next snap point ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#134](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/134) iOS theme: a native-like outer shadow on the bottom sheet ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#122](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/122) Add @transparentStatusBar: the iOS status bar shows the dimmed page (#113) ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#120](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/120) Render nested drawers outside the outer tray with the yielded Nested ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#110](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/110) iOS theme: the iOS 27 floating sheet ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#111](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/111) Focus rules: track the last input type instead of :focus-visible ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#105](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/105) Drag: catch up with the distance before the pan is recognised ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#106](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/106) Bounce the content past fully open like an iOS sheet ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#99](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/99) Move a drawer to its highest snap point when keyboard focus goes off screen ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#100](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/100) Let {{drawer.handle}} mark an always-drag area without @handleOnly ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#92](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/92) [T13] iOS spring presets and optional page scale effect ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#88](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/88) iOS theme: opaque sheet at full height (no grabber band) ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#86](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/86) [T11] Events and test-support helpers ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#71](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/71) Accessibility: @modal with focus trap, inert page, Escape and scroll lock ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#77](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/77) iOS theme: sticky grabber at the leading edge; theme docs fixes ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#80](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/80) Reset the tray scroll position when the drawer leaves its highest snap point ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#69](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/69) Optional iOS (Liquid Glass) theme stylesheet (CSS part of #29) ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#65](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/65) Backdrop: opacity, tap-to-close and @backdrop={{false}} ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#59](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/59) Scroll vs drag handling ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#48](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/48) Drag the drawer with didPan ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#47](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/47) Align top and left drawer content to the leading edge ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#42](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/42) Add the MobileDrawer component ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#40](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/40) Base CSS with custom properties ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))

#### :bug: Bug Fix
* `ember-mobile-drawer`
  * [#144](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/144) iOS theme: a closing floating sheet moves down as one piece ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * iOS theme: a closing floating sheet must move down as one piece, not collapse ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#138](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/138) iOS theme: Chrome clips the blur of the floating sheet correctly ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#125](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/125) Keyboard fill: fill to the screen bottom also with the transparent status bar ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#123](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/123) Fill the gap below a partly open drawer while the iOS keyboard is open ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#117](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/117) Keep a gesture in a nested drawer out of the drawer around it ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#114](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/114) iOS theme: no flat shadow band above the floating sheet ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#108](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/108) Scroll reset: ignore the modal drawer's first focus and readonly fields ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#103](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/103) iOS Safari 26: give the bar at the sheet's edge the sheet colour ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#96](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/96) iOS theme: draw the glass rim over the grabber strip, document the strip limits ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#95](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/95) Scroll reset: hold only for focused fields, keep the speed on resizes, add tests ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#94](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/94) Make a nested modal drawer modal while its parent peeks ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#87](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/87) iOS Safari 26: color the status bar and toolbar from the backdrop and the sheet ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#75](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/75) Only scroll drawer content at the highest snap point (iOS drag from 50%) ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))

#### :memo: Documentation
* `ember-mobile-drawer`
  * [#140](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/140) README: correct the glass layer upgrade note ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#133](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/133) Fix four README API notes and the dev server port ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#131](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/131) Add an API reference and a quick start for each placement to the README ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#112](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/112) Docs: the iOS grabber strip is 14px ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#107](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/107) Remove the iOS gap fill after the content bounce ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#93](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/93) Playground: show and change the spring settings ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#91](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/91) Correct the iOS toolbar notes and the keep-glass example ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#60](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/60) Playground in the demo app, deployed to GitHub Pages ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#58](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/58) Demo: color-scheme, dark page background and side drawer width ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#49](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/49) Document visual proof, approvals and merge checks in CONTRIBUTING ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#35](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/35) Add PR template, contributing workflow and release setup docs ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))

#### :house: Internal
* `ember-mobile-drawer`
  * [#127](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/127) iOS demo: stop the list separators 16px before the sheet edge ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#102](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/102) Keep Chrome rendering when its window is occluded, time-limit frame waits in tests ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#97](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/97) Wait for resize observations in the resize tests ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#67](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/67) Fix demo grabber shape in handle-only mode and top drawer placement ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#64](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/64) Playground: fix ?points= URLs in development builds ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#57](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/57) Declare @glimmer/component as a peer dependency ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#54](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/54) TypeScript consumers: optional @glint/template peer, bundler resolution documented, consumer type check ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#53](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/53) check-exports: correct the CSS comment and error message ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#44](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/44) Tighten package exports: explicit entries, README list, allow-list check ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#41](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/41) Keep -private modules out of the public package exports ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#37](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/37) Add snap-point model (resolution, flick projection, rubber-banding) ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#38](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/38) Add spring physics primitive ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#34](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/34) CI: test against ember 6.12 LTS and allow beta/canary to fail ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))
  * [#33](https://github.com/nickschot/ember-mobile-drawer/pull/33) Scaffold v2 addon with @ember/addon-blueprint ([@nickschot](https://github.com/nickschot))

#### Committers: 1
